product.schneider-pc1512.summary: The first Amstrad PC that Schneider brought to the German market.
product.schneider-pc1512.history: Schneider marketed Amstrad’s PC1512 in Germany in 1986 for homes and offices. In October, Happy Computer listed a price of DM 1,999 with one floppy drive and a monochrome monitor. The PC1640 expanded the range the following year.
product.schneider-pc1512.technical.limit: A BIOS attributed to a Schneider unit is needed for comparison with Amstrad’s firmware and validation in BluMach.

product.schneider-pc1512.technical.detai: The monitor also supplied power to the system unit. Separate cables carried the RGB signal and power.
